units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 21:30">Targ. Y. Ex. XXI, 30</cite> (h. text <cite ref="B01124"><he>כפר</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 15:32">Targ. Y. Num. XV, 32</cite> <he>ק׳ דשבתא</he> the penalty for violating the Sabbath laws.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 3a:10">Snh. 3ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 15a:15">B. Kam. 15ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M01652"><he>מָמוֹנָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 29b:2">Keth. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>בני ק׳</he> persons for whose seduction a fine is due.

<cite ref="Pesachim 29a:4">Pes. 29ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 30a:2">30ᵃ</cite> <he>ר״ש ק׳ קניס וכ׳</he> R. S. (in declaring leavened matter kept over Passover forbidden even after Passover) imposes a penalty, because the person has transgressed the law &c.
<cite ref="Yevamot 86a">Yeb. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ לעניים</he> the penalty (the forfeit of the tithes decreed over the Levites) was to benefit the poor; a. fr.—Pl. <he>קְנָסִין</he>, <he>קְנָסַיָּא</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 15:25">Targ. Y. I Ex. XV, 25</cite>.—Y. Yeb. XIV, beg. 14ᵇ <he>עוד היא באילין ק׳</he> she is still subject to those penalties (that she must leave both husbands).
